analysis: The supplied units are the head text of CHANGELOG.md only (lines 1-203 and 204 onward). The changed content is documentation. The changelog describes a new security-relevant behavior: removing emails, client IPs, device serials and MDA UDIDs from coordinator logs that are forwarded to Datadog. That change moves toward better privacy for T-051, T-058 and T-003-adjacent exposure. The logging change is described only in the changelog; its Go source was not supplied, so the claim that the PII is actually removed is unverified. It also describes other source changes (T-041 SSD cache TTL 30 minutes, SEC-035 re-acceptance, App Attest protocol 3 only, T-031 removal of the earnings lookup, attestation challenges failing closed). I found no concrete security regression or changed behavior in the changelog text itself. One note for the threat model: the 'Unreleased' entry says earlier logs are unaffected, so historical PII remains in Datadog. T-058 describes App Attest account, machine and credential IDs in logs; the new account_id/provider_id logging keeps stable identifiers in logs, which is consistent with the existing model. Next review passes should check the actual coordinator log and access-log code changes for the claimed removal of the `remote` field and the MDM webhook body preview. They should also confirm that other fields, such as the X-Forwarded-For header, are not still logged. Needs_deeper_review is false for this changelog-only batch, but coverage of the actual code is a limit.
